# Client throttling behavior

<!-- GENERATED by test/integration/compat.sh (throttle.sh) from run/compat/results-throttle-*.tsv. Do not edit. -->

Each client tool, with its default retry settings (and, for aws cli and boto3, also in adaptive retry mode), syncs objects through tollbooth against a rule whose rate is half the tool's concurrency and whose burst equals it (test plan category 7; test/integration/throttle.sh). *Landed* is counted direct at the backend after the run; *denied* is the rule's counter from `GET /admin/limits`; *floor* is `(objects − burst) / rate`, the least time the rule allows. A tool *completes* when it exits 0 and every object landed. s3cmd uploads sequentially, so its row is 40 objects under a 1 req/s rule.
